data.title: 斯卡蒂 · 潮汐归途的无言守望
data.action: 驻足在及膝潮涌中，单手立起冲浪板插入湿砂，侧身远眺
data.location: 深海悬崖天然凹湾沙砾滩
data.lighting: 暮色天际清冷的灰紫晚霞与潮水微光
data.description: 冷冽巨浪翻涌的深海峭壁之下，退潮后的砂砾滩泛着湿漉的水光。斯卡蒂赤足驻足在及膝的潮涌中，单手立起重型冲浪板插入黑砂。暮色渐深，灰紫色的晚霞与她的红瞳相互映衬，海风吹拂着她微湿的银发，她沉默地守在身侧，静听潮汐退去。
data.promptProse: Standing barefoot knee-deep in surging twilight surf beneath dark coastal cliffs, Skadi wears a matte-black tactical monokini with asymmetric side cutouts and gunmetal alloy rings. Planting one hand steadily atop a heavy surfboard driven upright into the wet black gravel sand, she gazes silently across the foaming tide as sea spray dampens her hair. Cool grey-violet dusk light settles across the rolling waves and towering cliff face.
data.animaCaption: Standing knee-deep in foaming surf beneath dark sea cliffs in her matte-black side-cutout monokini, Skadi rests one hand on a heavy surfboard planted in the wet sand and gazes quietly across the tide. Cool violet-grey twilight washes over the waves.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a matte-black tactical cutout monokini swimsuit accented with asymmetric side openings, gunmetal alloy rings, and a shark-tooth cord.
